# Inner Success

> Inner Success is a distinct methodology and a programme for leaders. It is designed for situations where capability itself is not the problem, yet leadership still becomes more effortful, more loaded, or more internally costly than it needs to be. The work is subtractive rather than additive: it removes the interference that gets in the way of clear judgement, clean authority, and freer access to existing capability.

Inner Success was originated by Tara Halliday. The methodology is delivered one-to-one by certified practitioners. Results are measured before and after, and current evidence indicates a consistent pattern of change across different practitioners using the same methodology.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://innersuccess.me/): Introduction to Inner Success as a programme for leaders, including the distinction between capability and interference, the concept of drag, and links to the deeper pages.
- [The Programme](https://innersuccess.me/programme.html): The 90-day one-to-one process, what kind of work this is, the four phases, what leaders often begin to notice, and how delivery works through certified practitioners.
- [What Changes](https://innersuccess.me/what-changes.html): How the shift shows up in practice, including forgetting to react, the "quiet week", easier authority, improved difficult relationships, and less internal drag in the same demanding conditions.
- [For Organisations](https://innersuccess.me/organisations.html): When organisations use Inner Success, why ordinary development may miss the point, what sponsors are approving, and the three deployment routes: one-off referral, team-based deployment, and internal practitioner training.
- [Evidence](https://innersuccess.me/evidence.html): Public evidence summary page covering measured outcomes, consistency across practitioners, what the data does and does not show, and the route to the full white paper.
- [Research White Paper](https://innersuccess.me/white-paper.html): The full scrutiny layer for readers wanting the fuller methodology, research basis, practice data, and written account behind Inner Success.

## Key Facts

- Programme for leaders, not a leadership programme
- Designed for cases where capability is present but access to it is being interfered with
- Defined one-to-one methodology delivered by certified practitioners
- Measured before and after using structured assessment of the interference itself
- Evidence includes consistent outcome patterns across different practitioners
- Follow-up reviews indicate sustained change over time
- More than 100 clients and more than 9 years of delivery
